PAC-MAN
=======

Controls:
  Arrow Keys / WASD  - Move Pac-Man
  ESC / P            - Pause
  1                  - God mode (invincible)
  2                  - Freeze ghosts
  3                  - Speed boost
  4                  - Skip level
  5                  - Extra life

Configuration:
  Edit config.json to change game settings.

How to launch:
  Run the pacman-42 executable in this directory.
  Or from source: python3 pac-man.py config.json
